frames.title: 冰谷：实际影像与山体层次
冰谷：实际影像与山体层次

method: Unmodified actual movie frames, selected one second into the same authored response. Each version has its own measured time. No generated previews, texture enhancement or identical-pixel claim.
limits: Original stylized teaching actors; no motion capture or ethnographic reconstruction.
Same 10m imagery and retained elevation data; lighting and view changes do not raise measurement precision.

findings.finding: Actual imagery retained. Closer valley framing and measured-height cavity shading improve relief reading; 10m snow/rock boundaries remain visibly coarse.
Parent and child occupy a closer eye-level composition; reply is visible beside the actual channel, with head-to-object and face attention.
Parent and child remain visible during the reply. Crowd and caravan move to the rear lane; cloth is visibly worn on the child after handoff.
Letter sits between actual hands; the child and adults look into the shared exchange. Lower caption leaves hands and faces visible.
Teacher and child can be seen across the table; learning record and grounded explanation marker remain visible without covering faces.
The close reply preserves distinct participants, waiting trucks and buffer vegetation; unmet need is retained in the scene and ending.

animationEvidence: Complete uninterrupted actual WebGL recording plus rendered hand/prop/contact logs; still images are not motion-capture or lip-sync evidence.
remaining: Faces and construction remain stylized miniature geometry; no realistic skin anatomy or photorealistic facial performance.
Amplitude driven lips/jaw do not certify phoneme sync.
Near terrain imagery remains at the existing source resolution.
All 41 played voice clips pass waveform first/tail and timing checks; subjective listening acceptance is still false.
